_readme: The carter, and the only NPC in the game who is not standing where you left her.
She exists to make the template's newest noun visible: `behavior` on her map record is
`patrol`, and the walking is template logic over that data - her dialog knows nothing
about it. Two nodes, no choices, no flags: a conversation is not what she is for.

greet.speaker: Carter
greet.text: Mind yourself - I walk this road all day and I'll not stop for you.

road.speaker: Carter
road.text: Up to the north road, down past the well, and back. Someone has to, and the elder is not going to.
